name: one-more-pass
description: A final review for writing and code before it goes public.

interface.shortDescription: Review writing and code before it ships.
interface.longDescription: One More Pass gives prose and code a careful final review. It protects meaning and voice in writing, then checks code against behavior, safety, tests, and release requirements.
defaultPrompt: Give this writing one more pass before I publish it.
Give these changes one more pass before I merge them.
